verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no account-wide data export and no open export formats such as CSV or JSON dumps. The only related material is a REST API that fetches individual records by identifier, which is a developer building block for building an export yourself, not an export capability. It earns no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: fetch the data via the API
